name: Humanoid Robot Controller
summary: A humanoid robot controller with a 12-core Arm processor, 64 GB LPDDR5 memory and 1 TB SSD. Its published configuration supports up to six EtherCAT ports, a minimum 125 µs control cycle and 100–275 TOPS AI compute; its stated mass is 900 g.

description.en: A humanoid robot controller with a 12-core Arm processor, 64 GB LPDDR5 memory and 1 TB SSD. Its published configuration supports up to six EtherCAT ports, a minimum 125 µs control cycle and 100–275 TOPS AI compute; its stated mass is 900 g.

specs.label: Ai compute
specs.conditions: Configuration: Humanoid Robot Controller; Manufacturer table configuration. Supported peripherals are not claimed as included hardware; AI compute range has no finer mode mapping.

seed.name: Humanoid Robot Controller
seed.summary: A humanoid robot controller with a 12-core Arm processor, 64 GB LPDDR5 memory and 1 TB SSD. Its published configuration supports up to six EtherCAT ports, a minimum 125 µs control cycle and 100–275 TOPS AI compute; its stated mass is 900 g.
